findings.title: URL construction vulnerable to injection
findings.description: AgentID and jobID are embedded directly in URLs using string formatting without URL encoding. If these values contain special characters (/, ?, &, #), they could be misinterpreted or break URL parsing.
findings.fix: Use url.QueryEscape() for query parameters or url.PathEscape() for path segments. Better: use url.URL builder.
findings.recommendation: Replace with: url.URL{Scheme: "https", Host: host, Path: "/api/jobs", RawQuery: url.Values{"agent_id": {r.cfg.AgentID}}.Encode()}
findings.impact: Potential URL injection or parameter pollution attack if AgentID/jobID are user-controlled.

findings.title: Authorization token sent without HTTPS enforcement
findings.description: Bearer token is sent in HTTP requests without enforcing HTTPS. Code doesn't validate that CoordinatorURL uses HTTPS scheme.
findings.fix: Validate CoordinatorURL scheme is 'https'. Consider detecting http:// and raising error or warning.
findings.impact: Token could be intercepted if coordinator URL is misconfigured to use HTTP.
findings.relatedTest: Test that http:// URLs are rejected in Config validation

findings.title: PollInterval logged but could contain sensitive timing info
findings.description: While logging poll interval is not directly sensitive, any configuration logged could leak information about deployment topology.
findings.fix: Avoid logging configuration values. Log only: runner started/stopped with neutral wording.

findings.title: Stop channel should be protected
findings.description: The stop channel (line 50) is unbuffered and not protected with mutex. Multiple goroutines calling Stop() simultaneously could panic.
findings.fix: Use sync.Once to ensure channel closed only once, or add mutex protection.
findings.impact: Low - unlikely in practice but defensive programming.
